messages.subject: Phil | Energy & Natural Resources Executive | Government Relations, ESG and International Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Phil,

Your work across Energy and Natural Resources, Industrial and Board and CEO Services makes this a focused introduction. I am pursuing senior international mandates where operating performance depends on government relations, ESG, stakeholder strategy and country-facing execution.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My current remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate and external affairs, strategic stakeholder engagement, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

My portfolio also includes stakeholder governance around large-scale solar and battery storage and carbon-data readiness, giving me direct exposure to the institutional side of energy transition and responsible industrial development.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across Government Affairs, External Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Social Performance, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership. I am internationally mobile and open to the UK, Europe, the Middle East and other global assignments.

I have attached an EMA Partners-tailored executive CV and would value consideration for current or future searches where this profile aligns with the mandate.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
